adaptation.selected_core: Projected Q/K scaled-sign quantization and learned compensation bias; optional P/V 8-bit floating fake-quant reference. Not a bit-packed CUDA implementation.
adaptation.draft_recipe_status: Explicit compact width/depth/patch/operator/initialization hypotheses; not original full visual-model profile, measured capacity, accuracy, latency or final-initialization parity.
adaptation.initialization: Temporal CLS/learned positions/relative bias truncated-normal std0.02; compact stem/Transformer/XYZ head use PyTorch defaults. No source pretrained, teacher or full vision final-init parity.
adaptation.readout: Final LayerNorm, CLS token, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head; explicitly not shared temporal GAP.
keep: Per-sample/per-head absolute-mean Q/K scale over token and feature axes, differentiable scale multiplied by source STE sign
Source sign convention: zero maps to +1
Source utils.py lines291/292 backward zero only for x.gt(1) or x.lt(-1), preserving gradients at BOTH exact boundaries -1,+1
Scaled projected-sign QK scores, learned relative compensation bias, softmax and floating attention/value matmul
Explicit pv_quant switch (draft true): probability round_ste UINT8 clamp0..255 and source symmetric 8-bit value quantization
Symmetric value scale127/(token-axis absmax.detach+1e-6), round/rescale; forward does not clip input; backward passes only open(-2,+2)
Pre-LN residual Transformer with floating V/residual/MLP and source-compatible CLS bias cases
replace: RGB patches -> ordered Conv1d(6,32,p4,stride4) temporal patches, never binarizing raw physical six-axis input
2D relative position table ->1D time-distance table plus CLS-to-token/token-to-CLS/CLS-to-CLS cases
Image learned positions/CLS -> temporal learned positions/CLS; classification/teacher head -> true XYZ Linear MSE head
Source fine-tuning/distillation/pretrained setup -> compact scratch-supervised D32/H4/depth2/MLP2 draft
omitted: Teacher distillation/classification objectives and any external image pretrained weights
Bit-packed binary CUDA/packed integer matmul implementation
Source low-bit hardware efficiency counters or BOP/64 interpreted as measured runtime FLOPs
Full vision/diffusion architecture wrappers and task losses
paper_code_adapter_differences: Closed [-1,+1] sign STE is the fixed source rule; an asymmetric interval or strict-open sign clipping is not this identity.
Value-quantizer backward open(-2,+2) is a separate source rule and must not be confused with sign STE bounds.
All sign/fake-quant values still use floating tensors/matmul, as released reference code. No paper binary-kernel acceleration transfers.
CLS readout differs from GAP candidates and must be explicitly reported.
D32/H4/depth2/p4/PVquant=true is a compact unmeasured adapter; no paper fine-tuning recipe or initialization equivalence claim.
adaptation.sign_backward_interval: closed[-1,+1]; gradients survive x==+1 and x==-1, source gt/lt lines291/292
adaptation.objective: Shared plain supervised MSE over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity only; set_loss rejects non-MSE or kwargs. No source-task/SSL/teacher losses mixed into this identity.
adaptation.input_permissions: Same admitted reference_oracle six-axis task view as controls; no image/text/skeleton/geography/initial velocity/extra sensor/targets in forward/per-test fitting.
adaptation.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; only admitted T200 samples, no outside-window context or persistent fast weights/hidden state/maps.
risks: Projected Q/K quantization discards magnitude detail except learned scales; V/residual mitigation is unverified for inertial velocity.
Quantizer boundary gradients and fake-quant switches require explicit tests.
Only measured real reference runtime may be reported, not transferred low-bit speed/BOP claims.

scientific_contract.output: vel:B,3 real supervised XYZ average velocity in m/s; no zero-padded Z
scientific_contract.xy_semantics: XY is the slice of the same XYZ prediction, no second XY model/head
scientific_contract.task_head: Final LayerNorm, CLS token, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head; explicitly not shared temporal GAP.
